notes.title: Tukoni now speak many languages, and want your answers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064494/0f714d417029f20e18a76a06ce165b20c89038b1.jpg[/img]

Greetings, our dear Forest Spirits!

We are happy to share that we have prepared the biggest update so far!

[b]We've added support for the following languages (listed in alphabetical order):[/b]
[list]
[*] Chinese (Traditional) and Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese
[*] Spanish - Latin America
[*] Thai
[/list]
[b]That's not all:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've added a link to our new questionnaire in the Main Menu. We'll be very grateful if you could find several minutes for us to answer these questions. If you have already played the game, here's a [b][url=https://forms.gle/GBTyKnwHNKFQ5y6K7]Google Forms link[/url][/b].
[*] A fix for the Tea Achievement bug,
[*] An Easter Egg about something coming very soon!
[/list]

As always, you can stay updated by [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dreamoperator]following our developer page[/url][/b] and Tukoni: Prologue page. Following would give you a chance to see all the exciting updates we have in store for you!

You can also follow [b][url=https://twitter.com/dreamoperator]Dream Operator on Twitter[/url][/b].

Last but not least, we have created a page for the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45039024]Tukoni franchise[/url][/b]. You can follow our news there as well!

Warm regards,
Tukoni Development Team

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064494/18911c06f4c4597332ef42acb965dc1b730a5b2d.jpg[/img]

Greetings, our dear Forest Spirits!

We are happy to share that we have updated the game's build.

[b]Here's what's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Turkish language support, thanks to the invaluable contribution of our player, Ahmet Yıldız,
[*] Fixed a critical bug that was blocking game progression,
[*] Implemented various UI/UX improvements for a smoother experience.
[/list]
As always, you can stay updated by [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dreamoperator]following our developer page[/url][/b] and Tukoni: Prologue page. Following would give you a chance to see all the exciting updates we have in store for you!

You can also follow [b][url=https://twitter.com/dreamoperator]Dream Operator on Twitter[/url][/b].

Warm regards,
Tukoni Development Team
